as_of_content:
[[File:Gold Bee Relic portrait.png|thumb|220x220px]]
The '''Gold Bee Relic''' is a relic.

==Description==
''A trophy commemorating the feats and trials of the diminutive Autobot [[Bumblebee]]. This is the award granted to those who master the Bumblebee GS Special Mission.''

==Relic Boosts==
+10% Gold Generation

==Obtainment==
The description implies that this relic was intended to be the reward for a Bumblebee Special mission or [[Bee's Gauntlet]], but ultimately did not come to pass. Instead the gold relic was given to Commanders who had logged in the game's first anniversary during v8.0 and the second anniversary.
